summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its annual general meeting (AGM) materials for 2026, including a notice of meeting, management proxy circular, proxy form, voting instruction form, and a modern slavery act report. The AGM is scheduled for June 12, 2026, with items including the receipt of audited financial statements, director elections, auditor appointment, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing with no special-situations event disclosed.
